name: 1942 Second Edition
notes: Territory inventory: ~/workspace/map-1942/inventory.md (transcribed from the physical 1942 2e board).
countries[] are Natural Earth ADM0_A3 codes. clip[] is an array of lon/lat rings;
a territory takes (union of its countries) intersected with its clips.
Order matters only within a shared-country group: each territory's geometry is
differenced against everything already claimed, so the LAST territory sharing a
country needs no clip and takes the remainder. No gaps, no overlaps, by construction.
Tiny islands use countries+clip too; if the clip finds no country geometry the raw
clip box is used as a fallback polygon (warns).
Assumed attachments (not on the board as separate territories, assigned to the
most plausible neighbor so no land renders unclaimed): DNK->northwestern_europe,
LIE->switzerland, SMR/VAT->italy, KAZ group takes UZB/TKM/KGZ/TJK, GEO/ARM/AZE->caucasus,
IRQ->persia, ISR/PSE/LBN/SYR->trans_jordan, SAU group takes YEM/OMN/ARE/QAT/KWT/BHR,
Unclaimed (no polygon rendered; documented holes): French Guiana (clipped out of FRA),
CYP, MLT, MDV, GUM, Pacific micro-islands, Caribbean micro-islands, STP/COM/SYC/MUS/CPV.

extras.note: Kaliningrad (East Prussia): in NE 50m it is part of RUS, not DEU
